text:
Ryan McDonagh is 37, back in Tampa for a second stint, and a two-time Stanley Cup winner with the Lightning. He plays 17 minutes a night now, rising to over 18 lately.

He has five points in 22 games, two goals in a week in early November, and the Lightning have won seven of his last ten. The on-ice goals have been kind to him: Tampa has scored 7.2 more than its chances deserve with him on, which flatters his on-ice results.

At five on five Tampa takes 54% of the expected goals with him on, though the team is slightly better without him. Our wins-added list has him near the bottom of the league, which says less about him than about what that stat measures: goals and saves, not shot blocks.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking still liked his defense at the blue line last season, stopping 15% of entries against an 11% norm. What to watch: whether the minutes hold up as the regular season grinds on.
